protocol.purpose: Measure six fixed replenishment probabilities around level 300 on the pre-completion-tuning snapshot. The experiment itself changes no production gameplay, save data or failure tracking; later one-star/painting changes are not included.
protocol.policy: Unchanged strong AI: four candidates, three sampled futures each, two turns deep. AI predictions use the same trial spawn distribution but independent random streams, without access to actual future draws.
protocol.selection: One reduced numeric type per independent seeded game, chosen using separate seededRandom(seed ^ 0x71a55c). Collection target types are excluded; other objective types allow all six. The reduced type stays the same across all six paired variants.
protocol.distribution: Only ordinary replenishment draws are weighted. Selected type has the reported absolute probability; each other type receives (1-p)/5. Initial boards and emergency recoloring are unmodified; cargo spawning and special-piece generation retain their rules.
protocol.controls: Same opening boards, level requirements, score thresholds and decision RNG seed for each paired variant. Refill streams share starting seeds; gameplay divergence changes consumption, so this does not hold later boards fixed.
protocol.attempts: Independent games at fixed assistance tiers, not successive retries or a cohort selected for previous failures. Active-effort thresholds, manual restarts, save persistence, human adaptation and cumulative clearance probability are not simulated.
protocol.tools: No hints or manual shuffles; automatic dead-board reshuffles retained.
protocol.scores: All-game three-star rate including losses; winning finale and 1500 points per unused move included. No finale for exhausted losing games.
protocol.uncertainty: Per-cell Wilson 95% intervals. Aggregate rates and paired differences use normal-approximation intervals across 1000 seed clusters, averaging the selected levels within each seed to retain dependence from seed reuse. Multiple tier/type comparisons are exploratory, with no multiplicity correction.
protocol.scope: Eight representative layouts around level 300 and one AI policy. Not a human win-rate estimate or evidence of a guaranteed monotonic benefit for individual players.

validation.baseline: All eight unweighted configurations reproduce the original engine exactly over two complete games each (16 comparisons).
validation.samplers: All six reduced types at all six probability tiers checked over 128000 generated ordinary pieces per combination: 4608000 pieces; absolute per-type frequency error below 0.004. All 36 tested initial boards match production.
validation.harness: Reusable harness copied source hashes match the running isolated experiment; all 48 combinations completed a one-game smoke run.

reproductionNote: Use --source to point at an engine checkout of the recorded commit and source hashes. Subsequent completion-score/painting tuning is intentionally excluded.

implementationAfterAudit.scope: Enabled after the one-star and L-corner changes; the 48000-game audit above remains a pre-tuning fixed-tier experiment and is not a joint estimate for the final adaptive system.
implementationAfterAudit.behavior: A natural exhausted loss, or a manual restart after max(8, ceil(initialMoves * 0.6)) spent moves, records one failure per attempt. Probabilities 15%,13.5%,12%,11%,10% begin on the next attempt. One non-collection-target type is fixed per level until victory. No extra count for quick restarts, exit or reload. Daily keys expire by date. Initial boards, cargo and reshuffle rules remain unchanged.
implementationAfterAudit.unaidedParity: The eight current production configurations still match the completion-tuning snapshot over 16 full games; zero-help baseline behavior is retained.
implementationAfterAudit.validation: 194 match-3 tests pass; Vite production build passes.
